text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1719001234 triggered: elevated 5xx rate (kv-cache) on hosted inference (all regions). Pager duty: maria is on call. See /incidents. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/1719001234 :rotating_light:

maria: digging in, seeing increased KV cache eviction and Redis errors around 09:12 UTC. Rolling restart of inference-proxy-g5 in progress. will update in 5.

raj: @maria can you dump the proxy logs? suspecting a config drift from last rollback.

maria: pasting tail of logs:
```
2024-06-12T09:11:54Z ERROR kv_cache: checksum mismatch key=conv-... shard=12
2024-06-12T09:11:54Z WARN cache: eviction spike=0.72
2024-06-12T09:12:05Z ERROR redis: connection reset by peer
```

taylor: switching route to model-variant-quantized to reduce load, applied 09:16 UTC. p50 improved but 500s persist for long-context sessions.

jamie-cs: quick question — customer-facing impact? which endpoints? we should prepare a short status note.

maria: impact: some chat sessions > 2048 tokens may see 500 or truncated streams. Not universal; estimated affected requests ~0.8% of traffic, higher in EU and APAC during peak.

jamie-cs: drafting status note now, pushing a short initial message for review.

jamie-cs: DRAFT:
"We are investigating an issue causing elevated errors for long-context chat sessions. Some customers may see failed or truncated streaming responses. Our on-call team is actively mitigting and will post updates every 30 minutes."

legal-bot: add compliance note? If customer contracts require immediate notification, please loop Legal.

maria: added @legal-review. Also posting timeframe estimate in internal comms.

legal: quick read — okay to publish. keep wording 'investigating' and avoid root-cause claims until RCA.

raj: ops playbook step — scale read-replica count temporarily and throttle background compaction. API hit for scaling:
```
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/scaleset -d '{"service":"kv-redis","replicas":6}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Applied at 09:25 UTC.

taylor: after scaling and routing change, error rate dropped from 0.8% to 0.15% by 09:34 UTC. still tracking regressions for >5k token requests.

jamie-cs: updated DRAFT for status page and email. New wording:
"Initial notice (09:30 UTC): Users may experience errors or truncated responses for long-context sessions. We have applied mitigations and error rates are decreasing. We'll provide another update by 10:00 UTC or sooner."

maria: pls include customer impact buckets: A) interactive chat sessions using >2048 tokens, B) batch embedding jobs unaffected, C) dedicated instances unaffected.

jamie-cs: added buckets. posting for sign-off: @maria @raj @taylor :eyes: 

maria: :thumbsup: publish from incident-runbook account when ready. Also annotate internal timeline.

ops-bot: Publishing to status page as draft (status.redwood.com/incidents/1719001234-draft) — confirm to publish.

jamie-cs: publish now.

ops-bot: Published initial update 09:36 UTC: https://status.redwood.com/incident/1719001234 — Incident page ID 1719001234.

cs-notify-bot: queued customer email to high-usage contacts for affected orgs (subject: "Service notice: temporary errors for long-context chat sessions")

maria: handing off to night on-call @li to monitor. leaving notes:
- mitigations applied: routing to quantized variant, scale read-replicas
- residual risk: rare 500s for >5k tokens
- next update scheduled 10:00 UTC

li: acknowledged, will watch and escalate if errors rise above 0.5%.

jamie-cs: internal post: file in #postmortems/1719001234 with initial timeline.

taylor: perf logs attached in ops-s3: s3://ops-logs/1719001234/perf.zip

maria: resolved note candidate after stabilization: "At 10:02 UTC we observed error rates return to baseline after redis scaling and routing changes. Root cause under investigation; a full post-incident report will follow." please review.

legal: OK

jamie-cs: final publish 10:05 UTC — ops-bot: update status page to "Monitoring" and publish resolved note? Wait resolved only once fully verified. We'll push 'Monitoring' at 10:05.

ops-bot: Status updated to 'Monitoring' 10:05 UTC. Next action: keep post updated and close when stable for 30m.

li: will close at 10:40 UTC if stable. :white_check_mark:
